description: This file defines a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` and a utility function `createProgressiveExpandController` for progressively processing a list of items in batches to keep UI responsive. It facilitates batch processing with support for requestIdleCallback fallback and provides progress callbacks and cancellation support.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object to process items in batches asynchronously, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, with progress and cancellation support.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that manages state and provides an interface to progressively process items using the controller.
